description: Source code for the fastlz lossless compression library, including compression and decompression functions, macros, and platform-specific optimizations.

methods.name: fastlz_compress
methods.description: Compresses input data using either fastlz1 or fastlz2 depending on size.

methods.name: fastlz_decompress
methods.description: Decompresses input data based on compression level embedded in data.

methods.name: fastlz_compress_level
methods.description: Compresses input data at specified compression level (1 or 2).
